response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS cnt FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), s AS (SELECT order_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.av
